result.question: Quais sao os 10 hospitais com maior volume de internacoes em UTI?
result.gold_sql: SELECT i."CNES", COALESCE(h."NO_HOSPITAL", 'Sem nome cadastrado') AS hospital, COUNT(*) AS internacoes_uti FROM internacoes i JOIN hospital h ON i."CNES" = h."CNES" WHERE i."MARCA_UTI" <> 0 GROUP BY i."CNES", h."NO_HOSPITAL" ORDER BY internacoes_uti DESC LIMIT 10;
result.generated_sql: SELECT i."CNES", COUNT(*) AS total FROM internacoes i WHERE i."VAL_UTI" > 0 GROUP BY i."CNES" ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 10;
